La capitale algérienne abrite à partir d: The Algerian capital is hosting the major African digital gathering starting this Tuesday. Gathered at the Exhibition Palace (SAFEX) in Algiers for the opening of the ICT Africa Summit, technology and digital stakeholders affirmed their determination to intensify efforts to support the continent's digitalization momentum. Objective: to strengthen infrastructure, stimulate innovation, and streamline the exchange of expertise between national and regional ecosystems.
Organisateur de l’événement, Majid Imada: Event organizer Majid Imadalou emphasized that this three-day exhibition aims to build bridges between innovative startups and experienced companies to foster knowledge transfer and open new avenues for collaboration. He announced the participation of more than 100 companies, including nearly 50 startups showcasing their innovations across various sectors.
Les opérateurs télécoms en première lign: Telecom operators on the front line
Hicham Andaloussi, PDG d’Algérie Télécom: Hicham Andaloussi, CEO of Algérie Télécom, described this event as a "space for exchange, reflection, and cooperation between public and private digitalization stakeholders," reaffirming his group's ongoing commitment to developing the country's digital infrastructure. Meanwhile, Rony Tohme, General Manager of Ooredoo Algeria, recalled his company's active contribution to accelerating digital transformation, both in Algeria and at the continental scale. "We are working to offer concrete technological solutions designed for businesses, particularly in cloud computing, 5G, and artificial intelligence," he stated. On the sidelines of the exhibition, Ooredoo also signed a strategic partnership with the Algerian Group of Digital Actors to join forces in accelerating the development of the national digital system.
L’industrie locale au cœur de la dynamiq: Local industry at the heart of the dynamic
Hachemi Benali, président du Groupement: Hachemi Benali, president of the Algerian Group of Digital Actors, praised the importance of such events as "true spaces for sharing experiences and strengthening cooperation among all technology stakeholders." In the same vein, Lotfi Mahboub, commercial manager of Bomare Company (owner of the "Stream" brand), highlighted the contribution of national production to the development of the information technology sector in Algeria and Africa. He added that the company is continuing its efforts by launching new products aligned with local manufacturing and import reduction objectives.
Forum sur la mobilité intelligente : des: Smart Mobility Forum: Solutions for the Future
En parallèle, un forum consacré au thème: In parallel, a forum dedicated to the theme "Strengthening Smart Mobility Solutions" allowed participants to emphasize the importance of a comprehensive strategy integrating modern technologies into transport management and operations. Stated objectives: to improve efficiency, enhance safety, and provide faster, more sustainable services.
Une édition 2026 sous le signe de l’enve: A 2026 edition marked by continental scale
Placé sous la haute autorité des ministè: Held under the high authority of the Ministries of Interior, Posts and Telecommunications, Knowledge Economy, Health, and Vocational Training, this summit takes place from April 21 to 23, 2026.
Au programme :Sessions plénières et atel: On the agenda: Plenary sessions and hands-on workshops, Presentation of the latest technological solutions, Business meetings and a competition dedicated to African startups, International exhibition bringing together companies, institutions, and research centers. The event brings together policymakers, entrepreneurs, investors, academic researchers, and representatives of numerous national institutions around a common goal: accelerating Africa's digital transformation.
Quatre forums thématiques pour relever l: Four thematic forums to address major challenges: This 2026 edition is enhanced by four specialized forums addressing key issues: Modernization of health systems, Development of digital administration, Smart mobility, Digitalization of the energy sector. Discussions will also focus on strategic topics such as digital sovereignty, cybersecurity, smart cities, fintech, agritech, digital education, and Industry 4.0.
Après l’édition 2025 qui avait attiré pl: Following the 2025 edition which attracted over 15,000 visitors and 150 exhibitors, this summit confirms its position as a must-attend event for innovation and technological cooperation on the African continent.
